title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Data Scientist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT BOLDIN

Boldin is the financial confidence platform, an all-in-one planning tool that helps hundreds of thousands of households build, manage, and optimize their financial future. Every month, 20,000+ people create a free plan and thousands convert to paying subscribers. We are profitable, growing, and backed by a deep data asset: millions of planning sessions, roughly 2M conversational AI messages, and rich behavioral telemetry across the full customer lifecycle.

We are building our first dedicated data science function, and this role will define how Boldin uses data science, and who does it, for years to come.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring our first Lead Data Scientist to turn Boldin’s growing data into insights that shape what we build and how our customers plan their financial futures, and to build the team that carries that work forward. You will partner directly with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to drive decisions across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation through retention and expansion, and to productize data-driven features that deliver measurable value to customers.

This is a foundational, player-coach hire. You will not inherit a playbook; you will write one. You will start hands-on, defining our experimentation culture, establishing the metrics that matter, and proving that data science can move the needle at Boldin. As the function grows, you will hire, mentor, and manage a small team of data scientists, setting the technical bar and the standards they work to. If you thrive on ambiguity, love working backwards from business problems, and want to grow from senior individual contributor into the leader of a function, this role is for you.

A note on scope: This role is designed to grow into a people-management position. You will begin as a hands-on senior contributor and take on direct reports as the function scales, so prior leadership experience is required.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and lead the data function. Set technical standards, establish ways of working, and, as the team grows, hire, onboard, mentor, and manage data scientists. Act as a player-coach: ship work yourself while raising the bar for everyone around you.
  • Own funnel analytics and optimization. Map the full customer journey, from first visit through paid conversion and long-term retention. Identify where people drop off, why, and what we can do about it. Define activation metrics and instrument experiments to move them.
  • Build and iterate on predictive models. Develop churn prediction, trial conversion scoring, and uplift models that power targeted interventions (email, in-app messaging, pricing offers). Measure what works through rigorous A/B testing.
  • Productize data science for customers. Partner with product to develop data-driven features, such as improved retirement score modeling, smart asset allocation recommendations, and personalized planning insights, that make our customers’ financial plans meaningfully better.
  • Establish experimentation rigor. Design and analyze A/B tests across product and marketing. Build frameworks so the broader team can run experiments confidently and interpret results correctly.
  • Define the metrics that matter. Work with leadership to establish the top-line KPIs that tell us whether we’re winning (customer lifetime value, activation rates, early churn, and more) and build dashboards that make them visible and actionable.
  • Advise on data enrichment. Identify external data sources (demographic, behavioral, financial) that could sharpen our models and improve targeting for acquisition and retention.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • 6+ years in product-focused data science, ideally within a cross-functional product team
  • 1+ years of leadership experience. You have formally managed data scientists or analysts, or served as a tech lead, project lead, or mentor with clear ownership of others’ work and growth. You are ready to take on direct reports, and you want to.
  • Advanced SQL and Python proficiency (pandas, scikit-learn, or equivalent)
  • Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments
  • Practical predictive modeling skills: classification, regression, model evaluation, and an emphasis on shipping models that drive decisions rather than optimizing for theoretical accuracy
  • Strong communication: you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for PMs, engineers, and executives
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You define problems first, then solve them. You don’t wait for perfectly scoped tickets
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, or similar) or equivalent experience
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


Preferred:

  • Experience as a first or early data science hire who went on to grow and lead the function
  • Experience hiring, building, or formally managing a data team
  • Experience with modern data stack tools (BigQuery, dbt, Looker, or equivalents)
  • NLP or text mining experience (especially relevant for our conversational AI data)
  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, or similar)
  • Background in financial services, SaaS, or subscription businesses
  • Exposure to uplift modeling, causal inference, or marketing mix modeling


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Flexible PTO and a team that values sustainable pace
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Budget for English lessons
  • The chance to build and lead a function from scratch, and to define how data science works at Boldin, and who does it
  • A mission that matters: helping people retire with confidence, not anxiety



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Finance Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Associate em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Prismapar is an advisory and venture firm specializing in M&A, corporate finance, business development, and venture funding for companies in expansion or strategic repositioning. The firm supports clients across business growth, mergers and acquisitions, strategic sales, and capital raising from banks, private equity funds, and capital markets. Acting as a “Business Development Partner,” Prismapar works from initial strategy formulation through implementation, helping managers stay focused on core operations during complex transactions. Prismapar also manages funds focused on venture capital and search opportunities, and advises international groups and private equity funds on opportunities in key Latin American markets.

Role Description Prismapar is looking for a Brazilian (or PT-BR native) ideally based in LATAM, although most of the work is remote. In this role, the Finance Associate supports advisory and venture projects by preparing and analyzing financial statements, assisting with financial reporting packages, and contributing to valuation and capital-raising analyses. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and updating financial models, conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis for client engagements, and organizing data and documentation for transactions such as mergers, acquisitions, and strategic sales. The Finance Associate will collaborate with senior team members, prepare clear summaries and presentations for internal and client use, and help ensure accurate, timely financial information for decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Finance, including understanding of corporate finance concepts and transaction processes.
  • Proficiency in Financial Statements and Financial Reporting, with the ability to interpret and prepare key reports.
  • Advanced Analytical Skills, including experience with financial modeling, data analysis, and scenario evaluation.
  • Effective Communication skills, both written and verbal, to present complex financial information clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced usage of AI and AI Agentic tools
  • Comfort working in Excel and other analytical tools; familiarity with presentation software (e.g., PowerPoint) is beneficial.
  • Detail-oriented approach, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in corporate transactions, venture funding, and Latin American markets; previous exposure to advisory or investment environments is a plus.

title: Client Success & Onboarding Specialist (Marketing Agency)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Success & Onboarding Specialist (Marketing Agency) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Onboarding Specialist (Marketing Agency)


Type: Part-Time (15–20 hours/week to start, with potential to increase based on client volume)

Schedule: US business hours overlap required


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Client Onboarding Specialist to join a fast-growing US marketing agency. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a client-facing environment, enjoys solving complex platform access issues, and takes ownership of every onboarding from kickoff to successful launch.


As the first point of contact after a client signs, you'll guide new clients through the onboarding process, secure access across multiple marketing platforms, troubleshoot technical roadblocks, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure campaigns can launch successfully.


Beyond technical expertise, we're looking for someone who communicates with confidence, builds trust quickly, adapts to different client personalities, and genuinely advocates for clients throughout the onboarding journey. You'll play a critical role in creating a positive first impression and setting the foundation for long-term client relationships.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding calls with new clients and confidently guide them through the onboarding process.
  • Own the onboarding process from kickoff through successful campaign launch.
  • Obtain access to all required marketing platforms, business assets, and tracking tools.
  • Assist clients with permissions, account setup, payment methods, verification processes, and platform configurations.
  • Troubleshoot platform access issues across Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify, Klaviyo, and other marketing tools.
  • Submit support tickets, appeals, and follow up proactively until issues are resolved.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a seamless transition after onboarding.
  • Identify onboarding roadblocks and independently drive them to resolution.
  • Create clear documentation of client access, permissions, and onboarding progress.
  • Maintain organized records of credentials, platform access, and onboarding status.
  • Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience while building trust and confidence with every client.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes and operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in client onboarding, account management, client success, agency operations, or similar client-facing roles.
  • Previous experience working in a multi-service digital marketing agency is required.
  • Fluent English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience leading client onboarding calls and managing client relationships.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical clients.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple onboardings, and follow through until completion.


Technical Experience


Hands-on experience managing access and permissions across several of the following platforms:

  • Meta Business Manager
  • Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, Google Business Profile
  • TikTok Business Manager
  • Klaviyo, Shopify, WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Framer


What We're Looking For

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ownership mentality—you take responsibility until the problem is solved.
  • Solution-oriented thinker who brings recommendations, not just problems.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and patience when working with different client personalities.
  • Confident leading conversations with clients and setting clear expectations.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Operational mindset with a passion for improving processes.
  • Professional, approachable, and confident—you'll be the first impression clients have of our agency.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), HubSpot, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools.
  • Basic knowledge of Google Analytics or marketing tracking implementations.
  • Experience with WooCommerce or other e-commerce platforms.
  • Familiarity with POS systems or online ordering platforms.
  • Digital marketing background with an understanding of paid media operations.
  • Spanish or Portuguese proficiency is a plus.

Liderar a estruturação, análise e disseminação de dados educacionais que orientam a tomada de decisão de secretarias parceiras e da própria organização. A pessoa será responsável por transformar dados brutos de avaliações e indicadores educacionais em análises rigorosas e acionáveis, além de contribuir para o desenho de interfaces e integrações que facilitem o acesso e uso desses dados por gestores públicos e equipes internas.

Reportando à Gerência da área, a pessoa atuará na interseção entre pesquisa aplicada, gestão de dados e advocacy local baseado em evidências, com forte interlocução com equipes de programas, tecnologia e parceiros institucionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


Monitoramento e análise de dados

  • Coordenar a coleta, estruturação e análise de dados de avaliações educacionais (ex: SAEB, avaliações estaduais/municipais, indicadores de fluxo e aprendizagem).
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos analíticos e preditores de resultados educacionais, conectando dados de insumo, processo e resultado.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas pela organização e por parceiros.


Estruturação de ferramentas de dados

  • Contribuir para o desenho e a evolução de interfaces e painéis de visualização que tornem os dados acessíveis e compreensíveis para gestores de secretarias.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de tecnologia na definição de requisitos de integração entre diferentes fontes e sistemas de dados educacionais.
  • Traduzir necessidades de gestores públicos em especificações funcionais para novas funcionalidades analíticas.


Avaliação e pesquisa

  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações de processo e de resultado dos programas da organização.
  • Produzir estudos, notas técnicas e relatórios que subsidiem decisões estratégicas internas e de parceiros.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre literatura acadêmica e evidências em política educacional, aplicando-as ao contexto de atuação da organização.


Gestão de relacionamento e comunicação de dados

  • Apresentar análises e recomendações para lideranças de secretarias, conselho e financiadores, de forma clara e orientada à ação.
  • Apoiar a preparação de materiais para reuniões estratégicas, conselhos e eventos externos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de programa para garantir uso efetivo dos dados na gestão escolar e na formulação de políticas.


Gestão de equipe e processos

  • Coordenar analista(s) e/ou estagiário(s) da área de monitoramento e avaliação.
  • Estabelecer rotinas e protocolos de qualidade para produção e validação de análises.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Economia, Estatística, Ciências Sociais, Educação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados educacionais, avaliação de políticas públicas ou pesquisa aplicada.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (ex: Stata, R, Python ou SQL).
  • Experiência com bases de microdados educacionais (Censo Escolar, INEP, SAEB, avaliações estaduais) é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações claras para públicos não técnicos.
  • Vivência em desenho ou especificação de painéis/dashboards e interfaces de dados (não é necessário programar as ferramentas, mas sim saber especificar requisitos junto a times técnicos).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e oral, com experiência em produção de relatórios e apresentações.


Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação (mestrado ou doutorado) em Economia, Educação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia em organizações do terceiro setor, secretarias de educação ou instituições de pesquisa educacional.
  • Conhecimento de métodos de avaliação de impacto (ex: diferenças em diferenças, matching, regressão descontínua).

  • Skilled stakeholder manager with a consultative, solutions‑focused approach.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese & Spanish.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BDR (Business Development Representative) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Data Scientist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT BOLDIN

Boldin is the financial confidence platform, an all-in-one planning tool that helps hundreds of thousands of households build, manage, and optimize their financial future. Every month, 20,000+ people create a free plan and thousands convert to paying subscribers. We are profitable, growing, and backed by a deep data asset: millions of planning sessions, roughly 2M conversational AI messages, and rich behavioral telemetry across the full customer lifecycle.

We are building our first dedicated data science function, and this role will define how Boldin uses data science, and who does it, for years to come.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring our first Lead Data Scientist to turn Boldin’s growing data into insights that shape what we build and how our customers plan their financial futures, and to build the team that carries that work forward. You will partner directly with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to drive decisions across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation through retention and expansion, and to productize data-driven features that deliver measurable value to customers.

This is a foundational, player-coach hire. You will not inherit a playbook; you will write one. You will start hands-on, defining our experimentation culture, establishing the metrics that matter, and proving that data science can move the needle at Boldin. As the function grows, you will hire, mentor, and manage a small team of data scientists, setting the technical bar and the standards they work to. If you thrive on ambiguity, love working backwards from business problems, and want to grow from senior individual contributor into the leader of a function, this role is for you.

A note on scope: This role is designed to grow into a people-management position. You will begin as a hands-on senior contributor and take on direct reports as the function scales, so prior leadership experience is required.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and lead the data function. Set technical standards, establish ways of working, and, as the team grows, hire, onboard, mentor, and manage data scientists. Act as a player-coach: ship work yourself while raising the bar for everyone around you.
  • Own funnel analytics and optimization. Map the full customer journey, from first visit through paid conversion and long-term retention. Identify where people drop off, why, and what we can do about it. Define activation metrics and instrument experiments to move them.
  • Build and iterate on predictive models. Develop churn prediction, trial conversion scoring, and uplift models that power targeted interventions (email, in-app messaging, pricing offers). Measure what works through rigorous A/B testing.
  • Productize data science for customers. Partner with product to develop data-driven features, such as improved retirement score modeling, smart asset allocation recommendations, and personalized planning insights, that make our customers’ financial plans meaningfully better.
  • Establish experimentation rigor. Design and analyze A/B tests across product and marketing. Build frameworks so the broader team can run experiments confidently and interpret results correctly.
  • Define the metrics that matter. Work with leadership to establish the top-line KPIs that tell us whether we’re winning (customer lifetime value, activation rates, early churn, and more) and build dashboards that make them visible and actionable.
  • Advise on data enrichment. Identify external data sources (demographic, behavioral, financial) that could sharpen our models and improve targeting for acquisition and retention.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • 6+ years in product-focused data science, ideally within a cross-functional product team
  • 1+ years of leadership experience. You have formally managed data scientists or analysts, or served as a tech lead, project lead, or mentor with clear ownership of others’ work and growth. You are ready to take on direct reports, and you want to.
  • Advanced SQL and Python proficiency (pandas, scikit-learn, or equivalent)
  • Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments
  • Practical predictive modeling skills: classification, regression, model evaluation, and an emphasis on shipping models that drive decisions rather than optimizing for theoretical accuracy
  • Strong communication: you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for PMs, engineers, and executives
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You define problems first, then solve them. You don’t wait for perfectly scoped tickets
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, or similar) or equivalent experience
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


Preferred:

  • Experience as a first or early data science hire who went on to grow and lead the function
  • Experience hiring, building, or formally managing a data team
  • Experience with modern data stack tools (BigQuery, dbt, Looker, or equivalents)
  • NLP or text mining experience (especially relevant for our conversational AI data)
  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, or similar)
  • Background in financial services, SaaS, or subscription businesses
  • Exposure to uplift modeling, causal inference, or marketing mix modeling


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Flexible PTO and a team that values sustainable pace
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Budget for English lessons
  • The chance to build and lead a function from scratch, and to define how data science works at Boldin, and who does it
  • A mission that matters: helping people retire with confidence, not anxiety



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Detalhamento do perfil: O profissional irá auxiliar o professor nas atividades referentes às atividades pedagógicas, recepção de alunos e pais, mantendo controle sobre a disciplina, orientando as crianças sobre hábitos de higiene;  participar do planejamento da rotina e da preparação de materiais para a decoração da sala de aula, visando atender o programa educativo da escola.Descrição da vaga:Salário (R$ 2516,05) + Benefícios; Vínculo de trabalho: Contrato por tempo determinado (90 dias); Carga Horária: 44h (Segunda a Sexta - 08:00 às 18:00;  Sábado - 08:00 às 12:00;  Folga Domingo).Requisitos da VagaEscolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo com Magistério ou Ensino Superior em andamento em Pedagogia.Conhecimentos técnicos e experiência exigida: Experiência profissional comprovada, mínima de 06 (seis) meses, na função.

title: Supervisor(A) De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supervisor(A) De Vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Local de trabalho:Salvador, BA (Presencial)Principais atividades:
- Participar estrategicamente dos processos de seleção, admissão, desligamento e movimentação de pessoal;
- Acompanhar e supervisionar a equipe, atuando em processos como medidas disciplinares, planejamento de férias e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores;
- Liderar o time de vendas, orientando e capacitando para o alcance das metas estabelecidas;
- Garantir relacionamento sólido e de confiança com a carteira de clientes;
- Conhecer profundamente a carteira de clientes para desenvolver ações estratégicas de vendas;
- Gerir recursos como orçamento, materiais de execução, investimentos, promoções e inovações;
- Apoiar o desenvolvimento de planos de negócios com metas de curto, médio e longo prazo;
- Realizar treinamentos para clientes sobre melhores práticas de vendas e temas relacionados ao negócio;
- Monitorar o ciclo de abastecimento dos clientes e propor ações para mitigação de riscos;
- Apoiar a prospecção de novos pontos de venda (PDVs);
- Zelar pelas ferramentas de trabalho e garantir o uso adequado dos EPIs;
- Garantir a correta execução das estratégias comerciais e ações de vendas;
- Atuar como ponto focal na capacitação, acompanhamento e engajamento da equipe de vendedores.Requisitos:
- Ensino Superior completo;
- Experiência comgestão de pessoas;
- Experiência na área comercial;
- Residir em Salvador, BA;
- CNH categoria B;
- Conhecimento do Pacote Office.Tipo de Contrato:TemporárioHorário de Trabalho:Segunda-feira a Sexta-feira: 08h00 às 18h00 (com 02h00 de intervalo) Sábado: 08h00 às 12h00Benefícios:
- Vale Alimentação;
- Vale Refeição;
- Vale Transporte;
- Convênio Médico;
- Convênio Odontológico;
- Seguro de Vida.
